title: artemisia rupestris var. viridis
intro: Artemisia rupestris var. viridis, commonly known as White Sagebrush, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its traditional uses in herbal medicine, where it is used to aid in digestion, relieve stress, and promote relaxation due to its soothing and calming effects. The health benefits of White Sagebrush are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which are a result of its bioactive constituents such as essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of White Sagebrush contribute to its ability to reduce anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
